content: Fixed-timestep + rAF render (Gaffer On Games canonical): accumulator loop carries remainder; if render needs a between-steps state, interpolate previous/current with alpha=acc/dt or expect visible stutter when render rate != step rate (60fps render vs 120Hz sim = alternate 1/2 steps). Spiral-of-death is prevented by clamping frameTime (code already clamps acc at 0.25s, max 30 steps). THREE.Clock.getDelta() returns seconds since last call and is wall-clock — mixing it with the sim's STEP=1/120 fixed dt double-counts time; the shell should keep performance.now accumulator as the only time source.
